offering_description.value: Holding company that owns outdoor billboard advertising, rural and suburban broadband internet, and insurance agency and specialty insurance businesses. It sells advertising space, internet access and insurance coverage to local businesses, households and other companies, delivering them through its own networks, sales staff and licensed insurance operations.

primary_services.value: outdoor billboard advertising; broadband internet access; insurance brokerage and specialty insurance

customer_segment.value: B2B: local and national advertisers renting billboard space, commercial insurance clients; B2C: residential broadband subscribers, individuals buying insurance coverage

revenue_model.value: advertising: billboard space leases paid by advertisers; subscription: monthly broadband internet subscriptions; interest or premiums: insurance premiums from policyholders through underwriting subsidiaries

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates billboard structures and fiber broadband networks; service provider: sells advertising space and internet access to businesses and households; financial intermediary: sells and underwrites insurance policies to individuals and businesses
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: US regional: Nebraska, Iowa, Texas, Kansas, Massachusetts and other states

specialization.value: diversified: separate businesses: outdoor billboards, broadband internet, and insurance

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales staff selling billboard space and broadband service; agents / brokers: insurance agency selling policies through brokers and agents

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance licensed by state insurance regulators, broadband under FCC and local rules, billboards under local zoning

notes: Business mix and state footprint are approximate and may have changed.
